products.name: Intravenous (IV) Cannula Set (With Wings & Port)
products.whatItDoes: Provides secure, comfortable, and reliable venous access for the rapid delivery of medications and fluids.
whyItsSafe: Manufactured by La-Med Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. under strict ISO guidelines.
Integrated port allows for needle-free secondary medication administration.
Flexible wings ensure secure skin fixation, reducing patient trauma.
products.specs: Available Specs (Gauges): G14, G16, G17, G18, G20, G22, G24, G26

products.name: Sterile Blood Transfusion Set (With AirVent)
products.whatItDoes: Ensures the safe, controlled, and sterile delivery of blood and blood components to the patient.
whyItsSafe: Features a built-in AirVent to maintain a steady, uninterrupted flow rate.
Designed with an advanced filtration chamber to prevent micro-clots and debris.
Kink-resistant medical-grade tubing guarantees reliable delivery during emergencies.
products.specs: Drip chamber volume: 20 drops/ml | Filter mesh: 200 microns

products.name: Carboplatin Injection (150mg/15ml & 450mg/45ml)
products.whatItDoes: Essential platinum-based chemotherapy agent for ovarian, lung, and head/neck carcinoma treatment.
whyItsSafe: Sourced directly from audited oncology parenteral manufacturing units.
Shipped in thermal-insulated containers with digital continuous temperature tracking.
Accompanied by Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and batch test release data.
products.specs: Storage: 2°C to 8°C | Vials per box: 10 Vials | FDA CSP Ready

products.name: High-Pressure Seamless Steel Medical Gas Cylinder (40L Oxygen)
products.whatItDoes: Provides high-purity medical oxygen storage for ICU respirators, emergency crash carts, and surgical suites.
whyItsSafe: Constructed from high-grade 34CrMo4 alloy steel tested to 200 bar operating pressure.
Fitted with Pin-Index / DIN standard chrome-plated brass valves for leak-free sealing.
Includes individual hydrostatic test certificates and serial batch stamping.
products.specs: Water capacity: 40 Liters | Working Pressure: 150-200 Bar | Valve: CGA 540 / BS 341

products.name: Cuffed Endotracheal Airway Tube Set (Sterile)
products.whatItDoes: Maintains open airway and ventilation during general anesthesia and critical care intubation.
whyItsSafe: High-volume, low-pressure cuff reduces tracheal wall mucosal trauma.
Radio-opaque line along full tube length enables accurate X-ray position check.
Smooth Murphy eye protects against accidental airway occlusion.
products.specs: Sizes: ID 3.0mm to 9.0mm (0.5mm increments) | Standard 15mm connector
